Five intervals I_j intersect the last length-2gamma interval in exactly three pieces, yielding four claimed densities. Bounded-type gamma continued fractions give O_h(log N) discrepancy for any fixed finite interval union. Independently generated 50,000 letters by morphism, checked every rotation coding symbol and recovered pair counts [14724,16178,7637,11461].
